ideas.title: Minnesota's plan to fight fraud underway as federal Medicaid money remains frozen
ideas.description: This story would investigate Minnesota's plan to fight fraud and the impact of frozen federal Medicaid money.
questions: What is Minnesota's plan to fight fraud?
How will frozen federal Medicaid money impact Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it involves a large-scale effort to combat fraud in Minnesota and the potential impact on Medicaid funding.
